field_principles.admitted_game_identity_leak_count: counts only game-identity leakage that entered credited primitives or live state, never rejected canaries.
field_principles.admitted_source_leak_count: counts only source leakage that entered credited primitives or live state, never rejected canaries.
field_principles.arc_registry_delta: zero prevents schema repair from inflating the public solve registry.
field_principles.arc_solve_credited: false prevents a gate corrigendum from claiming a solve.
field_principles.counterfactual_receipt_coverage_score: equals 1.0 only when all credited primitives meet paired-replay and trace-receipt existence gates.
field_principles.detected_game_identity_leak_canary_count: counts game-identity canaries that the negative-control harness detected and rejected.
field_principles.detected_source_leak_canary_count: counts source leak canaries that the negative-control harness detected and rejected.
field_principles.field_principles: every normalized field carries its own audit rationale so the corrigendum is schema-stable and principle-grounded.
field_principles.frozen_effect_hash: content-addresses the retained deletion effects so no effect size can be silently changed.
field_principles.frozen_primitive_ids: freezes the credited primitive identities in deterministic order for downstream live hardening.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal complete: or blocked: verdict states whether the lossless scalar schema repair is usable.
field_principles.live_policy_modified: false keeps schema normalization out of the submitted policy path.
field_principles.normalization_rules: documents the deterministic object-to-scalar and detected-vs-admitted leak transformations.
field_principles.normalized_schema_version: names the scalar gate contract consumed by downstream conductor gates.
field_principles.original_counterfactual_receipt_coverage: preserves the complete Exp5740 coverage object losslessly while adding a scalar gate field.
field_principles.positive_causal_primitive_count: copies the Exp5740 retained primitive count without re-mining or effect edits.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: fail-closed checks prove the source artifact, trace receipts, effects, registry state, and code immutability before normalization.
field_principles.registry_precheck: records that all 25 public games and all 183 registry levels were already complete before the corrigendum.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addresses the normalized artifact while excluding its self-checksum.
field_principles.science_rerun: false proves the artifact did not rerun mining, replay science, or live games.
field_principles.solve_provenance: development_proxy marks this as schema repair evidence, not live hidden-game self-discovery.
field_principles.source_artifact_hash: the corrigendum is valid only for the exact checked-in Exp5740 bytes.
field_principles.source_artifact_path: the normalized gate is explicitly tied to the Exp5740 source JSON rather than an inferred experiment number.
field_principles.source_schema_version: records the legacy object-valued gate shape being normalized.
field_principles.test_commands: records the verification commands used to validate the corrigendum.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: records the exit code of every verification command instead of relying on prose.

normalization_rules.description: Normalize only the exact checked-in Exp5740 bytes.
Emit 1.0 only when every retained primitive and trace receipt passes.
Rejected canaries stay visible but do not count as admitted leakage.
Hash retained effect payloads without changing any effect size.
Schema repair cannot bank a public-game or hidden-game solve.
